items.title: The spin wars about who wins and loses in the US-Iran 'ceasefire' have begun
items.description: The US-Iran deal faces five volatile days as questions remain over nuclear weapons and Israel's attacks on Lebanon.

items.title: Live: Plans to open Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran ceasefire reached
items.description: Pakistan, which has been negotiating peace talks between the US and Iran, says a deal to end the war has been agreed. Follow live.

items.title: The Trump-Netanyahu alliance was in chaos in the hours before the Iran deal
items.description: As Donald Trump was trying to push his Iran deal over the line, Benjamin Netanyahu bombed Beirut, showing once again the Israeli prime minister has other priorities.

items.title: Live: PM welcomes Iran–US ceasefire, urges Tehran to address concerns on nuclear
items.description: Anthony Albanese welcomes a ceasefire reached between the US and Iran, but urges Tehran to address "longstanding concerns" about its nuclear program. Follow live.

items.title: Live: ASX rallies, oil prices fall on US-Iran ceasefire agreement
items.description: The local share market and Australian dollar are rising after Donald Trump confirmed a ceasefire agreement had been reached with Iran, saying the Strait of Hormuz will open. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Smiling since last night': Community joy after Irankunda's World Cup goal
items.description: The family and community of Socceroos star Nestory Irankunda are "very emotional" after his goal-scoring World Cup debut. His cousin says he will be "forever grateful" for the support the family received after arriving in Australia, and "their blessing is seeing this at the big stage".

items.title: Police uncover note, unused life jackets at scene of 'senseless' murder-suicide
items.description: Investigators are trying to determine what led to a suspected murder-suicide on Saturday, after the bodies of a father and young child were recovered from a bay off Concord.

items.title: Cult musician Oliver Tree presumed dead after chopper crash
items.description: Ahead of his Australian tour, the American musician and online personality is reportedly one of six passengers involved in a fatal helicopter collision.

items.title: White House UFC event ends with massive upset win in title fight
items.description: US president Donald Trump watches ring-side as the UFC event dubbed Freedom 250 ends with Justin Gaethje scoring a massive upset win over Ilia Topuria at the White House.

items.title: Outbreak of this Victorian-era disease labelled a 'health disaster and tragedy'
items.description: Forty-two babies in Australia died from congenital syphilis between 2011 and 2025, with the outbreak driving health workers into communities to raise awareness of the old-world disease.

items.title: Mother of Perth girl shot dead in Pakistan 'in extreme shock'
items.description: A nine-year-old girl fatally shot by police who were pursuing armed robbers in Pakistan is remembered as happy and bubbly by the principal of her Perth school, as her family tries to deal with their "tragic loss".

items.title: Shackleton's hut could pose explosive risk to Antarctic explorers
items.description: Chemicals found inside two of Antarctica's most important historical sites, Ernest Shackleton and Robert Falcon Scott's huts, could pose "potential explosive hazards", a report has warned.

items.title: NSW residents say earthquake near dam sounded like an 'explosion'
items.description: The magnitude-2.9 earthquake was felt in parts of the Snowy Mountains just before 1pm on Sunday, according to Geosceince Australia.

items.title: Major highway closure hits 100 days as business payouts slammed
items.description: Mayors want the government to provide "adequate" funding for businesses that are closing and experiencing at least 50 per cent downturns due to the failure of Victoria Pass.

items.title: Simple 'fakeaway' recipes for when you're on a budget
items.description: Ordering in of an evening can become a costly exercise but these five tasty recipes are sure to hit the spot.

items.title: A lost Sam Pang went looking for something. He found comedy
items.description: This workplace satire starring Sam Pang has Tasmania's first ever AFL team firmly in its sights.

items.title: History quiz: Test yourself on these past events
items.description: When was Salt Lake City awarded the XIX Winter Olympics? And how much do you know about the Fast and the Furious films? Test yourself in this week's history quiz.

items.title: Vacant, underused land to make way for housing in next phase of Qld land activation
items.description: Three developers will take ownership of 6 hectares of state-owned land in Banyo in Brisbane's north and build townhouses, affordable housing and an aged care facility.

items.title: China's ability to hit Australia with missiles 'real and growing'
items.description: New analysis warns that China's military is developing a "real and growing" ability to hit the Australian mainland with missiles, and can already threaten Australia's trade routes, subsea cables and critical infrastructure.

items.title: Woman dies in rope jump fall in Brazil
items.description: In videos of the accident circulating online, two men hoist the 21-year-old above their heads and launch her off a bridge in São Paulo.

items.title: Paramedic 'haunted' by woman's death at hands of partner has since quit job
items.description: Those affected by the murder of Tiffany Spence, who died from horrific injuries inflicted by her partner Adam Britt, tell a sentencing hearing of the long-term impacts of her death.

items.title: Man who killed friend and hid dismembered body in freezer jailed for life
items.description: Justice Paul Smith says Bobby Weaver murdered his friend, 58-year-old David Thornton, "in cold blood".

items.title: Former police officer steps aside from country football over sexual assault charges
items.description: A female footballer has "stepped aside" from her country Victoria club after sexual assault allegations against her were revealed.

items.title: Why Cameron Munster is always Queensland's Origin saviour
items.description: Ever since his first State of Origin match, Queensland has looked to Cameron Munster in times of trouble. Now, with the series on the line at the MCG, his state will ask its greatest modern hero to do so again.

items.title: 'Absolutely terrified': Scolyer's doctor reveals fears of experimental therapy
items.description: Just 11 weeks before he died, Richard Scolyer cycled 500km in four days. In his last major TV interview, the celebrated pathologist tells Australian Story the secret to a fulfilling life and his doctor reveals the huge risks he took to try new brain cancer treatment.
